title: Plan
description: What the planner decided to change for one WorkItem, and how to verify it. Written by the planner as /workspace/plan.json, validated by the orchestrator, and followed by the builder. Internal to Factorial, but changed with the same care as the WorkItem contract.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Incremented only for breaking changes.

summary.description: The change in a few sentences: what it does and why. Shown in the pull request body.

steps.description: The change, in the order the builder should make it. At most 30. Step ids must be unique; validators check that separately, since JSON Schema cannot compare items by a field.

id.description: Short identifier the builder uses to report on the step, e.g. schema or handler-tests.

description.description: What to change in this step.

files.description: Repository-relative paths the step creates or changes. May be empty when the step changes no file. At most 50.

verification.description: How the builder confirms the step is done, e.g. a command and its expected result.

run.description: Commands to run once the change is made, e.g. npm run ci. At most 20.

add.description: Tests to add or change, one sentence each. At most 30.

risks.description: What could go wrong, for the builder and the human reviewer. At most 20; may be empty.

openQuestions.description: What the request leaves undecided, and the assumption the plan makes for each. At most 20; may be empty.
